reply: {"verses": [], "overall": "The translation is faithful to the Latin throughout: tenses (levavi perfect, veniet/uret/dormitabit future), the indicative/subjunctive contrast of custodit/custodiat in vv. 7-8, and the jussive det/dormitet in v. 3 are all preserved, and the supplied 'vem' (v. 2), 'é' (v. 5) and 'ele' (v. 3) are permitted additions. 'Não deixe vacilar' for 'non det in commotionem' is an acceptable idiomatic rendering of the concrete image, and 'para todo o sempre' is the standard equivalent of 'usque in saeculum'. Pointing marks match the Latin in every verse (a single mediant, no flex or second mediant)."}
